topo.title: Network Topology
topo.layout_tree_title: Tree: Internet → router → devices, in layers
topo.layout_star_title: Star: devices in a ring around their router, routers around the Internet
topo.float_title: Turn floating motion on or off. When off, a device stays where it is dropped
topo.set_grid_tip: Show a faint grid behind the diagram
topo.group_16_title: Group devices by /16 subnet (fewer, larger groups)
topo.group_none_title: Show every device without splitting them into subnets
topo.group_none_slow: All {n} devices are drawn at once, which may be slow. Grouping by subnet is recommended.
topo.set_dots_tip: Shows a coloured dot before the IP address; choose what it shows under "Dot Colour"
topo.set_highlight_tip: Darken the lines of the device under the pointer and fade the others
topo.set_localhost_tip: Show the 127.x.x.x group, which stands for the computer this system runs on
topo.set_internet_tip: Show the Internet symbol and the lines that leave it, without changing the layout
topo.set_public_ip_tip: Show the public WAN IP address under the Internet symbol (hide anytime for privacy)
topo.set_tooltips_tip: Show a small box with details when the pointer rests on a device or subnet
topo.dev_search_ph: Search IP, name, MAC or vendor
topo.dev_search_label: Find a device in the diagram
topo.bubble_auto: Collapsed automatically: the diagram shows at most {max} devices one by one, and the largest subnets are collapsed first
topo.float_paused: Paused automatically: more than {max} devices are shown
topo.set_dots_by_tip: Choose whether the dot colour shows open ports or CVE risk (only for devices that a vulnerability scan checked)
topo.js.val_not_checked: Not checked for CVEs in the selected scans
topo.reset_pos_title: Reset all device positions back to their default layout
topo.hint: Click a device in the diagram to see its details
topo.hint_bubble: Click a device in the diagram to see its details · Click + on a collapsed subnet to expand it
topo.js.internet_title: Internet / upstream network (symbol, not a scanned device)
topo.js.internet_pub_live: Current public IP of this machine: {ip}
topo.js.val_no_router: None identified in the scan data
topo.js.val_no_sysroute: No (known only from this computer's routing table)
topo.js.val_arp_cache: This computer's ARP cache (not from a scan)
topo.subnet.sys_gw: This computer's default gateway (OS routing table)
topo.subnet.localhost_note: Shown in the localhost group: this computer reaches the network through this router
topo.subnet.trace_last: Last router before {ip} on the traceroute
topo.subnet.vmac_hsrp1: Cisco HSRP v1 virtual router MAC
topo.subnet.vmac_hsrp2: Cisco HSRP v2 virtual router MAC
topo.subnet.edge_unverified: Link to the Internet not verified: no router was identified for this subnet
